(async()=>{const c=document.getElementById('game');const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();const s=Game.scale,oy=Game.oy;const P=(dx,dy)=>({clientX:r.left+dx*s,clientY:r.top+oy+dy*s});const sleep=ms=>new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,ms));const settle=async()=>{for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(Game.grid.animInPlay===0&&Tween.list.length===0){await sleep(140);if(Game.grid.animInPlay===0&&Tween.list.length===0)return;}await sleep(70);}};const tap=async(x,y)=>{c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y)}));await sleep(40);c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y)}));await sleep(160);};const log=[];const gold0=UserModel.I.gold;const btn=Game.popup.cur.buttons[0];await tap(btn.rect.x+btn.rect.w/2,btn.rect.y+btn.rect.h/2);await sleep(900);await settle();let mc=0;for(let x=0;x<5;x++)for(let y=0;y<8;y++){if(Game.model.getBlock(x,y))mc++;}log.push('chose='+btn.id+' popupOpen='+Game.popup.isOpen+' score='+Game.model.data.score+' blocks='+mc+' next='+Game.model.data.next+' curMax='+Game.model.data.curMax+' gold '+gold0+'->'+UserModel.I.gold);log.push('highScore='+UserModel.I.highScore+' maxValue='+UserModel.I.maxValue);return JSON.stringify({log});})()
